title: 第5章 传承至宝
content_zh:
赵鸾撇了撇嘴道：“那位大神开辟了这方世界后就从未出现过，只不过后来人均尊之为盘古父神”

赵硕下巴差点掉下来，满脸惊讶的道：“什么，盘古？”

赵鸾白了赵硕一眼道：“不错，正是盘古父神，混沌未开，天地鸿蒙如鸡子谓之盘，神通无上，伟力无尽谓之古，虽然众人都知道或许所谓的盘古或许不过是道之化身，显化盘古之身乃是为了开辟天地，不过后人依然尊之为盘古，不为道”

赵硕的心神平静了一些，微微点了点头，虽然盘古的称呼与自己所在的地球神话传说中的开天辟地的大神相同，但是却未必是同一人。倒是那猜测很有可能是真的，盘古为道之化身，出世即为开辟天地，天地即开，复归于道。

微微一笑，赵硕道：“小妹，说说九大星图吧，虽然上古时候九大星图破碎，我想就算是那些碎片恐怕也是无上至宝吧，毕竟是道韵显化之物。”

赵鸾道：“二哥，你什么时候变得这么聪明了，竟然连这都想得到”

赵硕闻言不禁撇了撇嘴，好似自己就该什么都想不到似地，狠狠的瞪了一脸笑意的赵鸾一眼。

经过几天的相处，赵鸾发现自己这位二哥似乎发生了巨大的变化，性格不再懦弱，甚至还开朗了许多，有时候思维速度就连自己都比不上，要知道自己就算不是天才级别，那也不比天才差多少，难不成自己这二哥挨了一顿打，竟然一下子成了天才不成。

若是让赵硕之道赵鸾在想些什么的话，不知道会不会狠狠的在赵鸾那小脑袋瓜上敲那么一下。

察觉到赵硕的目光，赵鸾不由得吐了吐香舌娇笑道：“二哥说的不差，九大星图破碎无数，散落四方，许多碎片为人所得，以之开启后人灵窍，靠着那些碎片，一个个宗门、世家出现，要知道那些星图就算是碎片，也一样蕴含着一方星空的奥秘，道韵仍在，可牵引星力，可开灵窍，仍是无上至宝。所以这些碎片就被称之为天级星图。”

赵硕点了点头，他当然知道星图可以分为天、地、人三级，至于最高的荒古级别，随着九大荒古级别的传承星图破碎，只怕再也没有多少可能重现在天地之间。

不过很快，赵硕疑惑的道：“不对啊，如此说来又怎么会有天、地、人、普通这种等级划分呢？”

赵鸾笑着道：“二哥，听你这么说就知道你以前在学堂的时候肯定没有用心听讲，不然也用不到小妹我帮你解惑了”

赵硕尴尬的笑了笑道：“好了，你知道二哥没你聪明的，快给二哥解惑吧”

赵鸾得意的道：“其实天级与地级、人级并没有太大的区别，无论是天级还是地级，人级，所划分的等级是针对所开启的灵窍等级而言，与其说是星图的等级，倒不如说是灵窍的等级。”

赵硕恍然道：“我知道了，也就是说这些星图碎片有的能够最大程度的开启天级灵窍，有的只能最大程度的开启地级或者人级灵窍，导致开启灵窍者修行速度产生巨大的差距，也就造成了星图的等级划分！”

赵鸾道：“不错，就如我和二哥，若是用人级星图开启灵窍，即便是走了大运也未必能开启地级灵窍，可是若有天级星图开启灵窍，那至少也是地级灵窍，甚至还有可能开启天级灵窍。”

赵硕闻言一脸向往的道：“可惜，上古星图的碎片就那么多，莫说天级，这望海城只怕就连地级的也未必存在。”

赵鸾点头道：“众所周知，诸多星图归根究底是来自上古九大荒古级别的传承星图碎片，蕴含玄之又玄之大道至理，不过在没有传承星图的上古时代，依然有无数的绝代天骄，观天地之变化，星辰运转之玄奥进而感悟大道开启灵窍，这时期凡是能够自行开启灵窍进而修行者，无一不是百年难得一现的奇才，造就了强者无数的上古辉煌。可是能够自行开启灵窍的毕竟太少，无数相较于现在的修者，可以用天才来形容的上古人类却因为无法自行开启灵窍而与修行无缘。星图的作用被发现之后，诸多道主强者灵机一动，为了将自己对大道之感悟，修行之秘法传承下来便寻找各种天材地宝炼制传承星图。无数星图出现也造就了如今的修行盛世。”

赵硕眼睛一亮道：“如此说来这些传承星图岂不是并不比那道韵至宝的碎片差多少？”

赵鸾点头道：“正是如此，当然这些道主后天炼制的星图同样有好有坏，但是至少可以用来开启灵窍，其作用并不比道韵星图碎片差。”

赵硕皱着眉头道：“我记得大哥和陈天贵进行的都是普通的星图传承来开启灵窍，所开启的灵窍只有简单的一重天，与人级三重天、地级六重天、天级九重天灵窍相比，修行速度简直相差数倍之多，除非出现奇迹，自己以莫大毅力自行开辟灵窍重天，不然将来的成就只怕有限啊。”

赵鸾道：“望海城的赵家、陈家、苏家各有一份人级的传承星图作为家族传承至宝，按照灵窍重天等级来看人级传承星图修行至法相位阶，能够拥有三尊法相就已经非常不错了。”

（开窍——淬体——元丹——固神——法相为修行诸位阶中前五个位阶。）

开窍期即为开启灵窍使周身灵窍畅通吸收外界天地元气打通体内诸多筋脉，筋脉畅通即为开窍圆满进阶淬体期。

淬体期即以吸收天地元气淬炼肉身，使肉身强大数十上百倍，当肉身强大至能够在体外形成一层罡气即罡气外放，天地元气开始汇聚丹田，进阶至元丹期。

元丹期即开始积累大量天地元气，当元气经历元气、元液、元丹，此时便可慢慢温养元丹，进阶至固神期。

固神期即锻炼元神，将元神凝练壮大，当元神大成之时即可进阶至法相期。

法相期即分裂大成元神之一缕形成分神融入元丹，元丹破碎化为法相，同时搜寻天地灵物以此锻炼灵躯，法相与灵躯相融即为法相大成。

但是一旦达到法相位阶，就意味着拥有一尊或者数尊法相分身，元神凝为实质，寿元无尽，等闲不会彻底陨落，可为长生之人。

此后修者无性命之忧亦可专心修法力凝法相，领悟大道法则之玄奥，为进阶至神通期做准备。所以此后各修者均为拥有大神通、*力之人，很少有道行高深法力浅薄这种事情发生。所以愈是高位阶，两大位阶之间愈是天地之差，如果说法相期前凭借着各种宝物还可以越阶杀敌的话，那么法相期后想要做到越阶杀敌简直难如登天。）

“大哥进行的是普通星图传承，恐怕灵窍只有一重天，再简陋不过，如此一来无论是吸收元力、还是领悟大道玄机都要差太多太多。”

听赵硕这么说，赵鸾道：“前些日子大哥打渔回来的时候，听大哥说他如今已经修行到了灵窍期大圆满，周身各大筋脉已然全部打通，随时都有可能进阶到淬体期，比陈天贵还要厉害呢，大哥的资质、悟性，并不算太差，可惜的是传承星图太差，灵窍只有区区一重天，如此一来牵引元力其慢无比。加上修行的时间晚了些，不然若是有好的星图传承的话，修行速度提升数倍，或许大哥如今已经有淬体期的修为了”

content_en:
Zhao Luan curled his lips and said: "That great god has never appeared since he opened up this world, but later everyone respected him as Father God Pangu."

Zhao Shuo's jaw almost dropped, and he said with surprise: "What, Pangu?"

Zhao Luan rolled his eyes at Zhao Shuo and said: "Yes, it is Pangu Father God. Chaos has not yet opened. The heaven and earth are as grand as a chicken, which is called Pan. His supernatural power is supreme and his power is endless. It is called ancient. Although everyone knows that the so-called Pangu may be just the incarnation of Tao. The purpose of manifesting Pangu's body is to open up the world, but later generations still respect him as Pangu, not Tao."

Zhao Shuo calmed down a little and nodded slightly. Although Pangu's name is the same as the great god who created the world in the myths and legends of his own earth, they may not be the same person.However, that speculation is very likely to be true. Pangu is the incarnation of Tao. When he was born, he opened up the world and the world opened up and returned to Tao.

Smiling slightly, Zhao Shuo said: "Little sister, let's talk about the Nine Star Charts. Although the Nine Star Charts were broken in ancient times, I think even those fragments are probably the supreme treasure. After all, they are the manifestation of Tao Yun."

Zhao Luan said: "Second brother, when did you become so smart? You even want to achieve this?"

Zhao Shuo couldn't help curling his lips when he heard this, as if he shouldn't have thought of anything, and glared at Zhao Luan who was smiling.

After getting along with each other for a few days, Zhao Luan found that his second brother seemed to have undergone tremendous changes. His personality was no longer cowardly, and he was even more cheerful. Sometimes his thinking speed could not match his own. You must know that even if he is not a genius, he is not much worse than a genius. It is possible that his second brother suddenly became a genius after being beaten.

If Zhao Shuozhidao and Zhao Luan were to think about something, I wonder if they would hit Zhao Luan's little head hard.

Sensing Zhao Shuo's gaze, Zhao Luan couldn't help but spit out his sweet tongue and said with a sweet smile: "Second brother is right. The nine star charts were broken into countless pieces and scattered in all directions. Many fragments were obtained by others, and they were used to open the spiritual apertures of future generations. Relying on those fragments, each sectWhen sects and aristocratic families appear, you must know that even if those star charts are fragments, they still contain the secrets of the starry sky.The Tao Yun is still there, and it can draw the star power and open the spiritual aperture, so these fragments are called heaven-level star charts."

Zhao Shuo nodded. Of course he knew that the star map could be divided into three levels: heaven, earth, and human beings. As for the highest ancient level, with the fragmentation of the inherited star maps of the nine ancient levels, I am afraid that there would be little chance of reappearing between heaven and earth.

But soon, Zhao Shuo said doubtfully: "No, how can there be such hierarchies as heaven, earth, human, and ordinary?"

Zhao Luan smiled and said: "Second brother, after hearing what you said, I know that you must not have paid attention to the lectures when you were in school. Otherwise, you wouldn't have needed my little sister to help you solve your doubts."

Zhao Shuo smiled awkwardly and said: "Okay, you know that the second brother is not as smart as you, so please help the second brother clear up his doubts."

Zhao Luan said proudly: "Actually, there is not much difference between the heaven level, the earth level, and the human level. Whether it is the heaven level, the earth level, or the human level, the levels are based on the level of the spiritual orifice that is opened. It is not so much the level of the star map, but the level of the spiritual orifice."

Zhao Shuo suddenly said: "I understand, which means that some of these star map fragments can open heaven-level spiritual apertures to the greatest extent, while others can only open earth-level or human-level spiritual apertures to the greatest extent, resulting in a huge gap in the practice speed of those who open spiritual apertures, which also results in the classification of star maps!"

Zhao Luan said: "Yes, just like my second brother and I, if we use a human-level star map to open a spiritual aperture, even if we get lucky, we may not be able to open an earth-level spiritual aperture. However, if a heaven-level star map opens a spiritual aperture, it will at least be an earth-level spiritual aperture, and it is even possible to open a heaven-level spiritual aperture."

Zhao Shuo said with a longing look on his face when he heard this: "It's a pity that there are only so many fragments of the ancient star map. Not to mention the heaven level, this Wanghai City may not even exist at the earth level."

Zhao Luan nodded and said: "As we all know, many star charts are ultimately fragments of inherited star charts from the nine ancient wilderness levels, which contain mysterious and profound principles. However, in the ancient times without inherited star charts, there are still countless peerless geniuses who observe the changes in the world and the mysteries of the rotation of stars, and then understand the great ways and open spiritual apertures. During this period, anyone who can open spiritual apertures on their own and practice cultivation is a rare talent that appears once a century, and has created countless strong men.The glory of ancient times.However, there are too few people who can open spiritual apertures on their own. Compared with today's cultivators, countless ancient humans who can be described as geniuses have no chance of practicing because they cannot open spiritual apertures on their own.After the role of star maps was discovered, many powerful Taoists had an idea. In order to pass down their understanding of the Tao and the secret method of cultivation, they searched for various heavenly materials and earthly treasures to refine and inherit star charts."

Zhao Shuo's eyes lit up and he said: "So these inheritance star maps are not much worse than the fragments of the Dao Yun treasure?"

Zhao Luan nodded and said: "That's right. Of course, these star charts refined by Taoist masters the day after tomorrow also have good and bad qualities, but at least they can be used to open spiritual apertures, and their effect is no worse than the Daoyun star chart fragments."

Zhao Shuo frowned and said: "I remember that my eldest brother and Chen Tiangui performed ordinary star chart inheritance to open spiritual apertures. The spiritual apertures opened were only simple first-level heavens. Compared with human-level third-level heavens, earth-level sixth-level heavens, and heaven-level ninth-level spiritual apertures, the cultivation speed is several times different. Unless a miracle occurs and I use great perseverance to open up the spiritual apertures on my own, my future achievements will be limited."

Zhao Luan said: "The Zhao family, the Chen family, and the Su family in Wanghai City each have a human-level inheritance star chart as a family inheritance treasure. According to the level of the spiritual aperture, the human-level inheritance star chart has reached the Dharma phase level. It is already very good to have three Dharma images."

(Opening the mind - Tempering the body - Yuan Dan - Strengthening the spirit - Dharma phase are the first five levels among the levels of cultivation.)

The awakening stage is the opening of the spiritual orifices so that the spiritual orifices of the whole body can be unobstructed, absorbing the vitality of the outside world and opening up many muscles and veins in the body. The smoothing of the tendons and veins is the perfect and advanced body quenching stage of the awakening.

In the body tempering stage, the physical body is tempered by absorbing the vital energy of heaven and earth, making the physical body tens or hundreds of times stronger. When the physical body is strong enough to form a layer of Gang Qi outside the body, that is, the Gang Qi is released, the vital energy of heaven and earth begins to gather in the Dantian, advancing to the Yuan Dan stage.

The Yuan Dan stage begins to accumulate a large amount of heaven and earth Yuan Qi. When the Yuan Qi goes through Yuan Qi, Yuan Ye, and Yuan Dan, you can slowly warm up the Yuan Dan and advance to the Gushen stage.

The Guishen stage is to train the Yuan Shen, condense and strengthen the Yuan Shen. When the Yuan Shen is fully developed, you can advance to the Dharma Phase stage.

During the Dharma phase, a strand of the Dacheng Yuanshen is split to form a divided spirit and merged into the Yuan Dan. The Yuan Dan is shattered and transformed into the Dharma phase. At the same time, spiritual objects in the heaven and earth are searched to exercise the spiritual body. The fusion of the Dharma phase and the spiritual body is the Dharma phase Dacheng.

But once you reach the Dharma phase level, it means you have one or several Dharma phase clones, the soul is condensed into the essence, the life span is endless, and you will not completely perish, and you can live forever.

From now on, practitioners can concentrate on cultivating Dharma and Condensation of Dharma without worrying about their lives, understand the mysteries of the laws of the Great Way, and prepare to advance to the stage of supernatural power.Therefore, all cultivators from then on are people with great supernatural powers and magical power. It is rare that people with advanced Taoism and shallow magic power happen.Therefore, the higher the level, the greater the gap between the two major levels. If it was possible to kill enemies beyond the level with various treasures before the Dharma phase, then it will be as difficult as climbing to the sky to kill the enemy after the Dharma phase.)

"My eldest brother is carrying out ordinary star chart inheritance. I am afraid that the spiritual aperture only has one level, which is very simple. In this way, whether it is absorbing the energy or comprehending the mysteries of the great road, there will be a lot of difference."

After hearing what Zhao Shuo said, Zhao Luan said: "When my eldest brother came back from fishing a few days ago, I heard that he had reached the Great Perfection of the Spiritual Aperture Stage. All the major veins in his body have been opened, and he may advance to the Body Tempering Stage at any time. He is even more powerful than Chen Tiangui. My eldest brother's qualifications and understanding are,It’s not too bad, but it’s a pity that the inherited star map is too poor, and the spiritual aperture is only one level, so the pulling of the energy is extremely slow.In addition, the time of cultivation is a little late, otherwise if there is a good star map inheritance, the cultivation speed will be increased several times, and maybe the elder brother will have the cultivation level of the body tempering stage now.”
